methods.quantile: ceil((n + 1) * (1 - alpha)); infinity if rank exceeds n
methods.tiePolicy: include all boundary ties; no randomization

tasks.definition: Classify a user utterance into one CLINC150 intent or the explicit oos class.
tasks.shift: The oos_test split is frozen as a controlled OOD slice and is not used for train or calibration.

tasks.definition: Classify a banking support utterance into one Banking77 intent.
tasks.shift: Nominal train/calibration/final-test rows are sampled from train.csv; the canonical test.csv is reserved as a source-separated shift slice.

pins.adapter: jev decision runtime binding for live collection; synthetic-open-data/v2 for offline proof

splits.train: Frozen labels/text only. Used for synthetic calibrated-risk baseline bins; no conformal quantile fitting.
splits.calibration: Frozen labels/text only. Used to fit conformal thresholds before final-test scoring.
splits.finalTest: Frozen labels/text only. Evaluated after calibration profile and gates are fixed.
splits.shift: Frozen labels/text only. CLINC OOS plus Banking77 test.csv rows source-separated from Banking77 train.csv; demonstrates where exchangeability assumptions are out of scope.

sampleSizeRationale: The bounded sample keeps git small while preserving at least 200 final-test rows per task and at least 50 rows on reported shift slices. Per-class support is intentionally sparse for high-cardinality intent labels; class-conditional coverage is reported as unsupported unless n >= 50 for the class. The sample is adequate to prove deterministic mechanics, not production representativeness.
baselines: raw primitive threshold: selected Choice probability >= 0.75
synthetic calibrated-risk threshold: train-only top-score decile Wilson upper error <= 0.12; not an approved D09 calibration profile
metrics: slice coverage when n >= 50; class-conditional coverage is unsupported for v2 classes with n < 50
mean, p50, p90 and p95 set size
calls, tokens and cost or approved bound

liveCollection.networkRule: No live provider call occurs unless the env gate is set, a credential and region are present, and the collector can reserve conservativeMaxTokensPerCall * conservativeUsdPerMillionTokens / 1,000,000 USD before each call or retry without exceeding liveHardCeilingUsd and liveMaxItems. Provider-reported usage replaces the conservative charge when present.

outcomeRule: Offline synthetic-score execution can prove the pipeline and produce INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE only. GO or CONDITIONAL requires separately approved live Jev scores or other representative held-out scores, D10 projection authorization, D14 lineage/retention evidence, and approved D09/D11 calibration evidence.
nonGoals: No Noul probability relabeling as confidence.
No Score study without a validated ordinal loss.
